content.user_title: Optimize React Native and Expo Applications
content.value_statement: React Native applications can suffer from unnecessary rendering, slow lists, and uneven animations. This skill guides coding assistants with prioritized rules and comparative examples for performance and native interface patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guide reviews of unsafe conditional rendering and text outside Text components.
Recommend virtualized lists, stable item references, lightweight rows, typed recycling pools, and appropriately sized images.
Explain Reanimated shared values, derived values, transform animations, and gesture-driven press feedback.
Guide React state simplification, functional updates, and React Compiler compatibility patterns.
Recommend native navigation, menus, modals, image components, safe-area handling, and layout measurement patterns.
Explain native dependency placement, shared dependency versions, build-time fonts, and reusable design system imports.
limitations: Provides written guidance and examples, not a standalone analyzer, profiler, or automated test suite.
Performance improvements require measurement on representative devices and application workloads.
Some examples require additional packages, newer React Native APIs, or native rebuilds.
Quick references and detailed rules contain inconsistencies; examples need project-specific review before adoption.

use_cases.title: Review a First Mobile Screen
use_cases.description: Check text rendering, conditional content, state variables, and touch components before shipping an Expo screen.

use_cases.title: Improve a Product Feed
use_cases.description: Review list virtualization, row props, image sizes, and subscriptions to identify likely sources of scrolling overhead.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Mobile Monorepo
use_cases.description: Review native dependency placement, version consistency, design system imports, and font configuration across shared packages.

prompt_templates.title: Check Rendering Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [component] for text outside Text and unsafe conditional rendering. Explain each issue and suggest the smallest correction.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single component

prompt_templates.title: Review List Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [feed component] for virtualization, unstable props, expensive rows, and oversized images. Prioritize changes and explain how to verify them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a scrolling feed

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Animation State
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [animated screen] for scroll-driven React updates and layout animations. Propose compatible shared-value patterns while preserving interaction behavior and accessibility.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Mobile Monorepo
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [app package] and [shared packages] against relevant rules. Prioritize dependency, compiler, and native configuration changes with compatibility checks and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Review a profile screen that renders its name and item count directly inside a View.
output: Wrap visible strings and numbers in Text components.
Use explicit boolean checks or ternaries for conditional components.
Verify empty names and zero counts without changing intended content visibility.

output_examples.input: Review a product feed that maps every item into a ScrollView and loads full-resolution product images.
output: Use a virtualized list with stable item keys.
Keep row props stable and move expensive work outside repeated rows.
Request images sized for their displayed dimensions and device pixel density.
Compare scrolling behavior and memory use on representative devices.

output_examples.input: Review a scrolling header that updates React state for every scroll event.
output: Use a Reanimated shared value for scroll-driven visual updates.
Derive translation and opacity without rendering the parent on every event.
Use a ref instead when scroll tracking does not drive the interface.

best_practices: Read the detailed rule before applying a quick-reference recommendation.
Check package versions, platform support, and accessibility before adopting native or gesture-based components.
Apply focused changes and verify behavior, rendering cost, and scrolling performance on representative devices.
anti_patterns: Treating illustrative snippets as complete, tested production components.
Applying every recommendation without checking application requirements and installed package versions.
Claiming performance gains without profiling or comparing behavior before and after changes.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides prioritized React Native and Expo guidance with explanations, incorrect examples, and recommended alternatives.

faq.question: Does the skill run a performance audit automatically?
faq.answer: No. It supplies reference material for an assistant; profiling, testing, and changes depend on the surrounding development workflow.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace lists support for these tools, and the guidance is written for coding assistants.

faq.question: Is it limited to Expo projects?
faq.answer: No. Many rules apply to React Native generally, while some examples use Expo packages and configuration.

faq.question: Do the examples require additional dependencies?
faq.answer: Some do. Examples reference libraries such as Reanimated, Gesture Handler, LegendList, FlashList, and expo-image.

faq.question: Are all recommendations compatible with older applications?
faq.answer: No. Check React Native versions, library APIs, platform support, and native build requirements before applying a recommendation.
